en: Sepia postcard showing two small boys in fur‑trimmed winter coats and folk caps standing on wooden skis in a snowy landscape. Caption at the bottom reads "Smaagutter paa Ski" with the credit "Wilse." The reverse has a Norwegian 'BREVKORT — CARTE POSTALE' layout, a handwritten Christmas greeting dated 1915, and an address to Einar Johannessen. Publisher imprint reads "A/S B. M. Schönbergs Kunstforlag, Kristiania."
